Investment income is taxed based on its specific source. Expenses are deductible only against the corresponding source of income [Doc 1]. For example, property tax expenses on rental properties are deductible against rental income from that same property [Doc 1].

Expenses directly incurred to earn investment income are deductible against the respective source of investment income [Doc 2]. These include:
